acceptance_predicates.description: The wizard header exposes complete/current/future/unavailable step states with non-color distinctions.
Normal terminals use a horizontal stepper and narrow terminals use a truthful compact fallback.
Navigation, toggle, continue, back, pane cycle, cancel, and help keys are consistent and modeled.
Keys cannot bypass validation or misrepresent draft/effect completion.

definition_of_done: Every reachable wizard route has a visible step location and a tested keyboard path.

gates.description: Formal transition and renderer/PTY tests cover every step state, key, and resize fallback.
